name: Stripe Sync
description: Syncs Drupal user roles from Stripe subscription status via Stripe Checkout + webhooks. Role changes are driven by the stripe module's WEBHOOK event, which the stripe module only dispatches AFTER verifying the Stripe signature (Webhook::constructEvent) — so a forged webhook cannot grant roles (safe). Requires the stripe module's webhook secret (whsec_) configured; store the Stripe secret key via env/Key.
